workflow.name: Pick topics
workflow.instructions: If the request does not name the topics, ask the person which ones they want, with these options: science, technology, business, finance, politics, sports, entertainment. Write the chosen topics to outputs/topics.md.

workflow.name: Read the news
workflow.instructions: Read outputs/topics.md. For each topic, read today's news from at least three different news sources. Note each story with its source name and link in outputs/sources.md.

workflow.name: Summarize news
workflow.instructions: Read outputs/sources.md. Write a short summary for each topic to outputs/news-summary.md, a few bullets per topic with a link to each story. Reply with the top story of each topic. The person can put this thread on a schedule in its settings to get the summary every day.
